The Rabbit Sanctuary 
Rabbit Rescue & Rabbit Adoption. 
We rescue rabbits from: council pounds, vets, off the street or in the bush, or private surrenders.
We rescue rabbits in partnership with RSPCA, AWL Animal Welfare League and other organisations that need our help.
States we rescue rabbits in: NSW | QLD | VIC | ACT
The Rabbit Sanctuary Locations:
Tweed Heads, Gold Coast, Coffs Harbour, Grafton, Lismore, Central Coast, Newcastle, Sydney, Melbourne. 
The Rabbit Sanctuary is located in Grafton, Northern Rivers in the Clarence Valley NSW Australia. 

The Rabbit Sanctuary assists people with rabbits with advice and with long term care when they have no other options. 
Adoptions to Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra, Ballina, Byron Bay, Coffs Harbour, Lismore and other places. 
Rabbit Services and Rabbit Training Courses
Rabbit Boarding | Pair Bonding Services | Rabbit Trick and Behaviour Training | Rabbit Handling & Care Skills
